notes.title: The Spirit Engine DX is a part of Debut Festival! + Demo Release Date
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, folks! We're partaking in another festival: Debut Festival, where games appearing from studios for the first time ever on Steam debut! Special thanks to the folks over at GameDev.ist for allowing us to participate.[/p][p]And, we can announce when our demo goes live.[/p][p]3rd of September, 2025.[/p][p]~aqx[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396282/249105543154eab4676d6acb5c44bf9e88ef8ac9.gif"][/img][/p]
